name: ChinaTravel
description: ChinaTravel is an open-ended benchmark for language agents focused on Chinese travel planning. It evaluates agents on complex multi-constraint challenges using authentic travel needs and a domain-specific language for compositional evaluation covering feasibility, constraints, and preferences.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark for Chinese travel-planning agents with limited evidence of broad community adoption so far.
notes: Focuses on real-world travel planning with multi-constraint challenges; uses a domain-specific language for evaluation.
